_comment: An ops node's harness config. It advertises the plansheet.ops capability, and for each action plansheet can dispatch, runs a configured command. RebuildDev clones prod into the dev database and reseeds the deterministic dev identity. This is what a plansheet.ops node runs on the box: point --harness (or HARNESS_CONFIG) at this file. Plansheet dispatches { Capability: plansheet.ops, Action: RebuildDev } through the hub; the node runs the command below and reports the RunStep back to plansheet. Adjust the script path to where deploy/scripts/rebuild-dev.sh lives on this box.

RebuildDev.Description: Rebuild the dev database from a fresh prod clone and reseed the deterministic dev identity.
